title: Top 10 RBI Approved Loan Apps List in India 2026
summary: 10 RBI registered loan apps with the bank or NBFC behind each, how to check RBI's DLA list in 2 minutes, and safe borrowing rules.
body_markdown:
RBI approved loan apps are loan apps whose money comes from a bank or NBFC regulated by the Reserve Bank of India. RBI does not approve apps one by one. Since 1 July 2025, RBI publishes a list of Digital Lending Apps (DLAs) on rbi.org.in, showing each app with its regulated lender (RBI press release, 8 May 2025). An app on that list, naming the same lender, is a genuine RBI registered loan app.


Below is the RBI registered loan app list for 2026, a simple list of RBI approved loan apps: 10 real, genuine loan apps with the lender behind each one, how to check any app on RBI's DLA list in 2 minutes, the borrower rights every safe loan app must follow, and how to spot a loan app not registered with RBI.


Question Quick answer


Does RBI approve loan apps? No. RBI regulates the bank or NBFC behind the app


Official RBI loan app list "DLAs deployed by Regulated Entities" on rbi.org.in (Citizen's Corner)


List live since 1 July 2025


Rules that apply RBI (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025, issued 8 May 2025


Can a loan app read my contacts? No. Access to contacts, call logs and media files is barred


Cooling-off period At least 1 day to exit by repaying principal plus proportionate cost


Google Play rule Personal loan apps in India must be on RBI's DLA list (existing apps from 28 Jan 2026)


Where to complain Lender's grievance officer, then RBI Ombudsman at cms.rbi.org.in or 14448


Facts in this table are from the RBI (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025 and RBI's press release of 8 May 2025, Google Play's personal loan policy, and RBI's Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2026 (retrieved 2026-11-02).


How this list is ordered: apps with a single, named RBI-registered lender come first, then apps that lend through partner NBFCs and banks. Every lender name below was checked on the app's or lender's own website on 2 November 2026. Interest rates change by profile, so the binding number is always the Key Fact Statement inside the app.


## What Is an RBI Approved Loan App?


An RBI approved loan app is a loan app backed by a lender that the RBI regulates, which means a bank or a registered NBFC. The app itself is only the front end. People search for "RBI approved", but the correct phrase is "RBI registered lender" or "listed in RBI's DLA directory". So whether you look for a loan app RBI registered or a personal loan app RBI registered, the real question is which lender stands behind it.


RBI says this clearly: being on its DLA list "shall not be construed as conferring any form of registration, authorization, or endorsement by the Reserve Bank" (RBI Digital Lending Directions, 2025, para 17). The list also relies on what lenders report, and RBI does not verify each entry. Treat the DLA list as a first check, not a guarantee, and still read the loan terms.


A regulated lender must give you a Key Fact Statement, pay the loan straight into your bank account, follow fair recovery rules, and answer complaints. An app with no regulated lender behind it owes you none of this. The[fake loan apps list](https://gromo.in/blog/fake-loan-apps-list/) shows what happens when borrowers skip this check.

## How to Check if a Loan App Is RBI Registered (RBI DLA List)


You can check any app in about 2 minutes. This works for every name, including apps that are not in our list.


1. **Find the lender's name.** Open the app's Play Store page or website and look for the bank or NBFC that gives the loan. Google Play now requires personal loan apps to name all lending partners in the description. No lender named means no download.
2. **Open RBI's DLA list.** Go to rbi.org.in, then Citizen's Corner, then "DLAs deployed by Regulated Entities". This is the RBI DLA list (also called the RBI DLA directory).
3. **Match the app and the lender.** Search the app name and check that the regulated entity shown is the same lender the app named. A different lender, or no entry, is a red flag.
4. **Check the RBI registered NBFC list.** For an NBFC, you can also confirm its registration in RBI's list of registered NBFCs on rbi.org.in.
5. **Read the Key Fact Statement.** Before you accept, the app must show the annual cost (APR), the EMI amount and penal charges in one place.


There is no official "RBI registered loan app list PDF" to download. RBI's list is online and updates as lenders report apps, so any site selling an "official PDF" is not genuine. In simple Hindi terms, "RBI se registered loan app list" means this same online DLA list.


## What a Safe Loan App Must Do: RBI Digital Lending Rules 2025


The RBI (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025, issued on 8 May 2025, set the rules that every genuine loan app must follow. Use them as your test for safe loan apps.


Rule What it means for you


Key Fact Statement You see APR, EMI and penal charges before you sign


Direct disbursal Money goes only to your own bank account


Direct repayment You repay straight to the lender's account, not an agent's


No hidden credit limit increase Your limit cannot go up unless you ask


Cooling-off period At least 1 day to exit by repaying principal plus proportionate cost, with no penalty


Data access No access to contacts, call logs or media files; camera, mic or location only once for KYC with consent


Recovery agent details Sent to you by SMS or email before the agent contacts you


Grievance officer Must be named; if there is no reply in 30 days, go to the RBI Ombudsman


The rules above are from the RBI (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025 (retrieved 2026-11-02). For how lenders may and may not recover dues, read our guide to[RBI loan recovery guidelines](https://gromo.in/blog/rbi-loan-recovery-guidelines/) .


## Loan App Not Registered With RBI: Warning Signs


Searches for a "non RBI registered loan app list" are growing, but no official list of unregistered apps exists. The government does not publish the names of the 87 illegal loan apps it has blocked under Section 69A of the IT Act (Lok Sabha reply, December 2025). So use these warning signs instead.


- **Money asked upfront.** A genuine lender takes its fee out of the loan amount. Paying first to "unlock" a loan is a scam.
- **No lender named.** If you cannot find the bank or NBFC, it is not a real loan app.
- **APK link instead of Play Store.** Since Google Play requires RBI DLA listing, unlisted apps push APK downloads on WhatsApp or SMS.
- **Contacts and gallery permission.** RBI rules bar this. An app that asks for it is breaking the law.
- **Money paid through a person.** Loan money must reach your bank account directly from the lender.


Already stuck with one? Report harassment on 1930, cybercrime.gov.in and RBI's Sachet portal.

## How to Apply on an RBI Registered Loan App


1. Download the app from the Google Play Store or Apple App Store only.
2. Register with your mobile number and complete KYC with PAN and Aadhaar.
3. Add income and job details honestly; they must match your bank statement.
4. Read the Key Fact Statement: APR, processing fee, EMI and total repayment.
5. Accept the offer. The money reaches your own bank account, usually the same day.


Eligibility (common) Documents


Age 21 to 60 (some apps from 18) PAN card


Indian resident Aadhaar for KYC


Salaried or self-employed with steady income Salary slips or bank statements


Bank account linked to your mobile GST or ITR for self-employed


Low CIBIL score? Read our guide to a[loan app without CIBIL](https://gromo.in/blog/loan-app-without-cibil/) before applying, and avoid 7 days loan apps with charges that are not in writing.

## FAQ: RBI Approved Loan Apps


### Is there an official RBI approved loan app list?


Yes, in a sense. Since 1 July 2025, RBI publishes "DLAs deployed by Regulated Entities" on rbi.org.in, which lists each loan app with the bank or NBFC behind it. RBI says the list is not an approval or endorsement, so still read the loan terms.


### Which is the best loan app RBI approved in 2026?


There is no single best app. Pick by loan size: Tala and True Balance for small loans, Kissht, KreditBee and CASHe for mid loans, and InCred or Branch for bigger loans. Check each one in RBI's DLA list first.


### How do I check if a loan app is RBI registered?


Find the lender named on the app page, open RBI's "DLAs deployed by Regulated Entities" list on rbi.org.in, and confirm the app and the same lender appear together. It takes about 2 minutes.


### Is there an RBI registered loan app list PDF?


No. RBI does not publish a PDF of approved loan apps. The genuine source is the online DLA list on rbi.org.in, which updates as lenders report their apps.


### Which are the safe loan apps in India?


Safe loan apps are listed in RBI's DLA list with a named bank or NBFC, show a Key Fact Statement before you sign, pay money only to your bank account, and never ask for a fee upfront or access to your contacts.


### Are RBI registered loan apps safe from harassment?


They must follow RBI's fair recovery rules: recovery agent details are shared with you in advance, and apps cannot access your contacts. If a regulated lender harasses you, complain to its grievance officer, then the RBI Ombudsman at cms.rbi.org.in or 14448.


### Is CASHe loan app RBI approved?


CASHe's lender is Bhanix Finance and Investment Ltd, an RBI-registered NBFC. As with any app, confirm the pair in RBI's DLA list before you apply.


### What is an NBFC loan app?


An NBFC loan app is a loan app whose loans come from a Non-Banking Financial Company registered with RBI. Our NBFC loan app list covers the main ones.


### Where do I complain against a loan app?


For a regulated lender, first write to the grievance officer named in the app. If there is no reply in 30 days, go to the RBI Ombudsman at cms.rbi.org.in or call 14448. For a fake app or harassment, call 1930 or report on cybercrime.gov.in.


### Can I earn by referring RBI registered loan apps?


Yes. On GroMo, partners earn up to 4.5% of the loan amount on personal loans, depending on the lender, when a customer's loan is disbursed. Joining is free.

## Disclaimer


This article is for general information only and is not financial or legal advice. Being listed in RBI's DLA list is not an approval or endorsement by RBI. Lenders, partners, loan amounts and rates change often; verify the app and its lender on rbi.org.in and read the Key Fact Statement before you borrow. Borrow only what you can repay on time.
